title: Instant Pot Roasted Garlic
description: This Instant Pot roasted garlic recipe is quick and easy to make with three ingredients.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed

steps.text: Place a steamer basket in the bottom of a multi-functional pressure cooker (such as Instant Pot). Add water up to the bottom of the steamer basket.

Cut off top 1/4 inch of garlic head. Place head, cut-side up, into the steamer basket; drizzle with olive oil and season with salt. Close and lock the lid. Select Poultry function according to the manufacturer's instructions; set the timer for 10 minutes. Allow 10 to 15 minutes for pressure to build.

Release pressure using the natural-release method according to the manufacturer's instructions, about 10 minutes. Unlock and remove the lid. Transfer garlic to a plate and let cool until easily handled, about 5 minutes. Squeeze garlic pulp into a glass jar and refrigerate.
